components.doc:
Independent transport settings owned by NAN. Requests route directly to the NAN
module; the debug console does not participate. Omitted settings retain their
current values. Peer activation is a separate nan.wake command; the old aggregate
mode and wake_target fields are not part of this API.
components.name: transport

fields.description: 0 off, 1 on; omitted retains STA. Enabling requires an existing station profile.
fields.name: sta

fields.description: 0 default (8), 1, 8 or 16 discovery windows; omitted retains the interval.
fields.name: nan_dw_interval

fields.description: 0 default, 1 on, 2 off. Disabling the sync control plane is unsupported.
fields.name: now

fields.description: 0/1 selects 115200, 6 selects 230400, 7 selects 460800, 8 off, 9 selects 921600. Serial on also restores a detached USB PHY; USB ignores baud.
fields.name: uart

fields.description: 0 default, 1 start, 2 stop. Sleep policy uses rendezvous while sleeping.
fields.name: ble

fields.description: 0 default or 2 PPP. Other framing is unsupported.
fields.name: uart_mode

fields.description: Explicit supported physical baud; overrides selector 18. USB ignores it.
fields.name: uart_baud

fields.description: Radio frequency in Hz for this activation.
fields.name: radio_frequency

fields.description: Radio transmit power in dBm; negative values currently unsupported.
fields.name: radio_tx_power

fields.description: LoRa spreading factor, 5..12; zero uses the default.
fields.name: radio_spreading_factor

fields.description: LoRa coding rate, 5..8; zero uses the default.
fields.name: radio_coding_rate
